codes.delegation.invalid_config_schema: Couldn't check the settings because the delegation strategy's settings schema is invalid.
codes.flow.loop_invoked_only: This node is only called by delegation, so it doesn't run inside the loop. Move it out of the loop or add an incoming edge to it.
codes.interaction.kinds_not_allowed: Interaction kinds the edge type doesn't allow are ignored.
codes.interaction.no_path: Permission mode {permission_mode} asks for tool approval during runs, but there is no path to answer (a tool approval interaction edge), so those requests are handled automatically as {unmatched_permission}.
codes.interaction.unsupported_by_backend: This node's backend can't take some interaction kinds.
codes.interaction.unsupported_in_delegate: As a delegate, this node can't open some interactions with this delegation strategy.
codes.review.dead_end: A review decision doesn't lead anywhere. Choosing it ends the team's run.
codes.settings.invalid_value: A setting wasn't applied because its format is wrong.
codes.settings.widened: A lower layer widened the scope set by an upper layer.
codes.team.agent_not_found: Couldn't find the node's agent definition {agent}.
codes.team.backend_capability_missing: The delegator's backend doesn't support a capability this delegation strategy needs.
codes.team.connects_mismatch: This edge type can't connect these nodes.
codes.team.delegation_cycle: The delegation edges form a cycle.
codes.team.entry_not_executable: The entry edge goes to a node that doesn't run.
codes.team.flow_from_delegate: A delegate can't have outgoing edges with this delegation strategy (its result only goes back into the delegator).
codes.team.lookup_unavailable: Can't run the nested team node: no way to look up teams is available.
codes.team.member_field_ignored: This delegate setting doesn't apply with this delegation strategy (the delegator's value is used).
codes.team.mixed_invocation: This node receives edges or the entry and is also called by delegation. Split the agent into two nodes.
codes.team.no_entry: There is no entry. Draw an entry edge to the node that should receive user messages.
codes.team.no_reply: There is no reply edge. The team runs, but no reply appears in chat.
codes.team.unreachable: This node doesn't run because it has no incoming, entry or delegation edges.
codes.team.validator_failed: Couldn't compute the preview notes of backend {backend}.
